card.name: Start of 'contraindicated' after 'is'
card.fires_on: The first piece 'contr' of the word contraindicated, right after 'is' or 'are' in a sentence saying a drug or combination is contraindicated. Also seen at the start of the section heading CONTRAINDICATIONS.
